reuse.why: Threads the flag into the existing getFillableCategories and forEachBulkCategory helpers that every month-wide action already uses, rather than adding new selection logic.

duplication.why: The hidden rule is now decided only in getFillableCategories (the redundant hidden/group_hidden check in copyPreviousMonth is removed), but the `{ month, includeHiddenCategories = false }` argument type is repeated verbatim across six exported actions instead of a shared args type.

placement.why: The hidden-category rule stays in the fillable-category query in budget/actions.ts, where the other exclusions are defined.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions and their shared helpers are touched.

maintainability.why: One optional parameter on the shared selection function is easy to follow; small blemishes are the conditional SQL fragment interpolated into the query, an over-long comment line and the repeated argument types.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions select categories via getFillableCategories/forEachBulkCategory.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is copied; only type declarations repeat.
